short.zh: 在单行道地图上一条条找
short.en: Trace them one by one on a one-way map

t.zh: 这是一张小镇地图。每个地点是一个格子，每条单行道是一根箭头，只能顺着箭头走。
t.en: Here is a map of a small town. Each place is a cell and each one-way street is an arrow, and you can only travel the way the arrows point.

t.zh: 一条路线，就是从家出发、顺着箭头一站站走、最后到达学校的一串地点。比如：家 → 面包店 → 学校。
t.en: A route is a sequence of places that starts at Home, follows the arrows stop by stop, and ends at School. For example: Home → Bakery → School.

t.zh: 请你亲手把所有路线找出来：从「家」开始，顺着箭头一个个点地点，点到「学校」就记下一条。
t.en: Find every route yourself: start at “Home”, click places one after another along the arrows, and each time you reach “School” a route is recorded.

goal.zh: 找出从家到学校的所有路线。只能顺着箭头走（单行道）。
goal.en: Find all the routes from Home to School. You can only go the way the arrows point (one-way streets).

how.zh: 从「家」开始，顺着箭头依次点地点。点错了，再点一下最后那个地点就能退一步。
how.en: Start at “Home” and click places in order along the arrows. If you click a wrong one, click the last place again to step back.

body.zh: 现在地图只有 4 个地点，一条条找还不算累。
body.en: With only 4 places on the map, tracing routes one by one isn’t too tiring.

body.zh: 但地点稍微多一点，路线就会多到找不完，还很容易漏掉或者重复。
body.en: But add a few more places and there are too many routes to trace, and it is easy to miss one or count one twice.

note.zh: 路线 = 从起点顺着箭头走到终点的一串地点。
note.en: A route = a sequence of places leading from the start to the end along the arrows.
